svg.text: As-built data model (migrations M0001 to M0011)
PK primary key · FK foreign key · UK unique · RLS = forced row-level security by company
Jobs and SAT cache (forced RLS; restricted global queue claims)
Ingestion (every table carries company_id and forced RLS)
link FKs use company_id + id; payment_ref targets cfdi_payment
cfdi_queue_owner: NOLOGIN BYPASSRLS, grants only on job/job_attempt.
cfdi_app: NOBYPASSRLS; functions pinned and EXECUTE not granted to PUBLIC.
